note: The bestiary of Aoaz in machine-readable form. Every entry has the same id and section as in the bestiary document. Card sizes are the owner's figures (a man is 1.8 m); no age or life span of any being is stated (K18). playEffects are proposals for the systems that own them; target names state modifiers of the installed game or proposed ZIN decisions, events, ideas and units. habitatFlag is the proposed state flag that marks a creature's states. Regions use the roster keys (tritons_islands is the Pupor Isles).
